task: Implement and adopt canonical VX Smart Auto-Fix: classify Publish Readiness diagnostics through an explicit safe-repair registry, produce explainable preview-first stale-safe repair plans only for deterministically repairable findings, apply them through existing Builder authorities as one undoable document commit, and fail closed to MANUAL/BLOCK/UNKNOWN for every unsafe, stale, external, semantic or pixel-only diagnostic.

exceptions.reason: Intentional fail-closed undeclared-Blueprint branch. template3AuthoringReady must remain false when no Generator Blueprint is declared, even though the canonical declared production maturity catalog now technically clears VX-SMART-AUTOFIX. This consumer expresses absence-of-declaration, not the pre-wave Smart Auto-Fix blocker state.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: VX Smart Auto-Fix is the final mandatory VX blocker after lifecycle-closed Publish Readiness and Smart Intent. Publish Readiness intentionally marks many findings as structured diagnostics, but structure alone is not proof that an automatic repair is semantically safe. Auto-Fix must therefore introduce no heuristic repair authority: it must classify each selected readiness finding, verify it against the current source authority, and emit an executable repair only when an explicit allowlisted rule proves a deterministic canonical schema operation. The initial safe registry covers redundant responsive inheritance overrides with dimension-local reset and Design Guard disabled with canonical warn-mode restoration. Semantic content, links, media, commerce, page completeness, unknown external evidence and pixel-only drift remain manual/non-automatic.
observableOutcomes: One canonical Smart Auto-Fix Core accepts the current Page Schema plus a selected Publish Readiness finding and returns READY, MANUAL, BLOCK or UNKNOWN.
READY is possible only through an explicit safe-repair registry entry that matches finding code, evidence source, repairability, localization and current authority state.

RESPONSIVE_INHERITANCE_REDUNDANT_OVERRIDE plans reset exactly the localized visibility, grid-placement, container or child-order dimension through existing responsive authorities rather than resetting unrelated dimensions.
PUBLISH_READINESS_DESIGN_GUARD_OFF plans restore the existing Design Guard to canonical warn mode through setStorefrontDesignGuardMode.

Missing alt text, heading semantics, unsafe links, commerce/media/page completeness, draft persistence actions, unknown diagnostic codes and unlocalized external findings never generate schema repairs automatically.
Pixel-only or visual-unlocalized drift always returns MANUAL with zero operations even when the overall readiness decision is BLOCK.
Each READY plan binds finding identity, source page fingerprint, exact authority state and an integrity hash; stale or tampered plans fail before mutation.
Apply executes on a clone through existing canonical setters, validates Page Schema, proves the targeted diagnostic postcondition is resolved, and returns no partial output on failure.
Active StorefrontVisualBuilderV3 exposes per-finding Auto-Fix planning and a separate READY-only apply action inside readiness review.
V3 Auto-Fix application enters ordinary Builder undo/redo history with exactly one commitDocument call and never saves, publishes or persists by itself.
Auto-Fix does not call Smart Intent natural-language parsing, an AI gateway, or Visual Diff pixel data to invent a repair.
VX-SMART-AUTOFIX becomes PROVEN only after Core plus active V3 adoption and adversarial executable proof.
After promotion, all mandatory Template #3 maturity blockers are PROVEN, but Template #3 authoring remains forbidden until the separate final end-to-end Brabus rehearsal passes.
unresolvedRisks: A structured diagnostic may be mistaken for an automatically safe repair.
A readiness finding may be stale even though its deterministic id still exists in UI state.
A broad responsive reset could erase unrelated explicit overrides.
Auto-Fix could silently repair a semantic accessibility issue by inventing text or URLs.
Pixel mismatch or hotspot evidence could be treated as a causal schema diagnosis.
An external/template-level finding localized to another page could mutate the active page.
A plan could be tampered after preview or applied after the document changed.
A canonical operation could resolve one diagnostic while creating a new fatal Page Schema violation.
V3 could auto-apply on plan generation or bypass Builder history.
Maturity could be promoted while the active UI has no usable preview/apply adoption.

Explicit safe-repair registry with source/code/localization/current-state verification.
Dimension-local repair of proven redundant responsive inheritance overrides.
Canonical Design Guard off -> warn repair.
Explicit MANUAL classification for semantic, external, unsupported and pixel-only diagnostics.
Source page fingerprint plus deterministic plan hash and tamper/stale rejection.
Preview-first apply through existing responsive/fidelity authorities and final Page Schema validation.
Postcondition verification that the targeted safe diagnostic is resolved after apply.
Active V3 per-finding plan/preview/apply adoption with ordinary history.
Maturity promotion and Template #3 blocker-list regression proof.
out: Automatic copy, alt-text, heading, link, route, product, commerce or media invention.
Automatic page creation, draft save, persistence, publish or rollback.
Pixel-diff-to-schema causality, hotspot repair or screenshot authority.
General AI/LLM repair selection or Smart Intent text parsing.
New Page Schema, responsive, fidelity, readiness, visual-diff or persistence authority.
Batch repair-all orchestration in the first Brabus capability.
Control Plane/guard/policy changes unless this wave independently proves a persistent authority deficiency.
Template #3 authoring before final end-to-end Brabus rehearsal.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Auto-Fix sits directly between diagnostics and schema mutation, so false repair is worse than an unsupported manual finding. Highest practical assurance is an explicit finite repair registry, exact source-code/evidence matching, localized current-state verification, source fingerprint and plan-hash freshness, dimension-local canonical setters, preview-before-apply, final schema validation, postcondition proof and active UI adoption. Unsupported findings fail closed rather than using heuristic inference.

acceptanceCriteria: Smart Auto-Fix Core exposes a versioned READY/MANUAL/BLOCK/UNKNOWN plan contract.
Every non-READY plan has zero executable operations.
A READY plan requires a registry rule whose expected finding code, source authority, repairability and localization all match.
Redundant responsive inheritance repair resets only the exact finding.location.path dimension and leaves sibling dimensions untouched.
The responsive repair is rejected if the current inheritance authority no longer contains the matching safeReset diagnostic.
Design Guard repair is READY only while the current mode is off and applies canonical warn mode without replacing unrelated fidelity metadata.
Pixel-only and structuredCause=false Visual Diff findings are always MANUAL and cannot enter the repair registry.
Structured accessibility/link/media/commerce findings without an explicit safe rule remain MANUAL; repairability=structured-diagnostic alone is insufficient.
Plan hash changes if any operation, finding binding, authority, fingerprint or repair explanation changes.
Apply rejects invalid plan contract, non-READY status, tampered hash, stale page fingerprint, page mismatch or stale authority state before returning a changed document.
Apply clones input, uses existing canonical setters, validates resulting Page Schema and proves the targeted diagnostic postcondition is gone.
V3 exposes separate Auto-Fix plan and apply controls on a selected readiness finding and never auto-applies from rendering or planning.
V3 apply calls commitDocument exactly once for a successful READY repair.
Core and V3 contain no AI gateway, save/publish/persistence authority or pixel-to-repair implementation.
Production maturity promotes VX-SMART-AUTOFIX only with Core + active V3 executable evidence.
Template #3 maturity may become technically ready only if every required capability is PROVEN; actual Template #3 authoring remains separately gated by final Brabus rehearsal.
invariants: Diagnostic structure is not repair authority.
Only explicit safe registry entries may produce operations.
Manual-review and visual-unlocalized findings never produce operations.
One repair plan targets exactly one readiness finding.
Responsive repair is dimension-local and exact-viewport only.
READY plans are fingerprint-bound and hash-bound.
Apply is atomic, schema-valid, postcondition-proven and persistence-free.
Active UI always separates planning from application.
Final end-to-end rehearsal remains mandatory before Template #3 authoring.

failureModes: Missing alt text receives fabricated alt copy because readiness says structured-diagnostic.
Unlocalized pixel drift produces a guessed width/spacing mutation.
Responsive redundant visibility finding resets grid/container/child-order as collateral damage.
Finding disappeared after another edit but stale UI repair still applies.
Plan operation is edited after preview and hash is not revalidated.
Design Guard warn repair overwrites preset/protected-node fidelity metadata.
A finding points to another page but active page is mutated.
Repair resolves target symptom but creates a fatal Page Schema violation.
V3 runs apply immediately after planning without user confirmation.
Capability is marked PROVEN while Auto-Fix UI is not present on the active V3 route.
edgeCases: Redundant override warning exists for only one of four inheritance dimensions.
Two redundant dimensions exist on the same node but one finding is selected.
Selected finding is warning/PASS state but is safely repairable.
Design Guard already changed from off to warn between plan and apply.
Finding code is known but evidence source is unexpected.
Finding has structured-diagnostic repairability but no localization nodeId or viewport.
Visual Diff diagnostic claims structured cause but no explicit safe repair registry entry exists.
Current Page Schema fingerprint changes only in an unrelated node after plan.
Canonical repair operation becomes a no-op before apply.
Unsupported external evidence remains explainable MANUAL rather than UNKNOWN when source/code are known.

alternatives.summary: Explicit allowlisted repair registry verified against current authority state and applied through existing setters.
alternatives.reason: Makes automated mutation evidence-backed and fail-closed without inventing a second diagnostic or schema authority.

alternatives.summary: Automatically repair every readiness finding marked structured-diagnostic.
alternatives.reason: Structured localization does not prove semantic repair safety; it would fabricate content/links or overreach external authorities.

alternatives.summary: Use a model to infer fixes from readiness text or visual mismatch.
alternatives.reason: Would make mutation probabilistic, blur Smart Intent/Auto-Fix boundaries and violate pixel-drift non-causality.

specialistReviews.finding: Publish Readiness already provides canonical evidence identity; Auto-Fix should be a repair planner/adapter, not a second diagnostic engine.
specialistReviews.resolution: Consume StorefrontPublishReadinessFinding and verify against source authorities before planning.

specialistReviews.finding: Repairability metadata is broader than safe automatic repair and stale diagnostics can mutate the wrong state.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require explicit registry membership, current-authority revalidation, page fingerprint, plan hash, schema validation and postcondition proof.

specialistReviews.finding: Auto-Fix must remain understandable and reversible instead of becoming invisible automation.
specialistReviews.resolution: V3 shows selected finding, repair explanation/operations, separate plan and READY-only apply; apply is one ordinary history entry.

specialistReviews.resolution: Run Release Risk after Plan/Edit/Replay; split Core and UI if budget blocks.

challenge.scenario: Publish Readiness emits ACCESSIBILITY_IMAGE_ALT_MISSING for node hero-image with repairability=structured-diagnostic and an exact nodeId.
challenge.finding: The diagnostic is structurally localized but there is no evidence-backed text value that can serve as a truthful alt attribute; generating one would fabricate semantic merchant content.
challenge.resolution: The safe registry has no ACCESSIBILITY_IMAGE_ALT_MISSING executable rule. Planning returns MANUAL with zero operations, and tests assert that no config/text mutation is emitted.
MANUAL regardless of mismatch ratio/hotspot; zero operations.

challenge.scenario: Redundant mobile visibility override is selected.
challenge.resolution: READY with visibility-only reset at the exact node/viewport.

challenge.scenario: Same node also has explicit grid/container overrides.
challenge.finding: A broad reset would cause collateral mutation.
challenge.resolution: Operation resets only finding.location.path dimension; other direct overrides must remain byte-equivalent.

challenge.scenario: Finding was generated before user manually fixed it.
challenge.resolution: Planner revalidates current source diagnostic and returns BLOCK when no longer present.

challenge.finding: Repair plan source no longer exact.
challenge.resolution: Fingerprint mismatch rejects apply before any operation.
Deterministic plan hash mismatch rejects apply.

challenge.scenario: A PUBLISH_READINESS_DESIGN_GUARD_OFF finding is previewed while mode=off, then another Builder action changes Design Guard to warn before Auto-Fix Apply.
challenge.finding: The previewed repair is stale: applying the old plan would claim to repair a condition that no longer exists and could overwrite newer fidelity metadata.
challenge.resolution: Apply revalidates the live Design Guard precondition before mutation. If mode is no longer off it throws SMART_AUTOFIX_SOURCE_STALE and returns no changed document.

challenge.scenario: Known diagnostic code arrives from an unexpected evidence source.
challenge.finding: Code collision cannot confer repair authority.
challenge.resolution: Source+code registry key must both match or result is MANUAL/BLOCK.

challenge.scenario: External route/media/commerce issue has a path.
challenge.finding: Localization does not imply active-page schema ownership.
challenge.resolution: No registry entry; MANUAL and no mutation.

challenge.scenario: Canonical setter output violates Page Schema due unrelated state.
challenge.finding: Repair cannot return partial invalid output.
challenge.resolution: Apply works on clone and fails before returning changed document.

challenge.scenario: All maturity capabilities become PROVEN after this wave.
challenge.finding: Technical maturity alone must not start Template #3.
challenge.resolution: Keep authoring explicitly blocked until a separate full end-to-end Brabus rehearsal passes.

proofPlan: Plan Before Code projected-scope and Release Risk proof before substantive implementation.
Safe-registry matrix proves source+code+repairability+localization are all required for READY.
Responsive adversarial matrix proves visibility/grid-placement/container/child-order repairs are exact-dimension and preserve all unrelated state.
Design Guard proof verifies off->warn preserves edit mode, preset id, baseline version and protected node ids.
Unsafe diagnostic matrix proves accessibility content, link, media, commerce, page completeness, visual pixel and unknown external findings are MANUAL/UNKNOWN with zero operations.
Freshness proof verifies stale page fingerprint and stale source diagnostic both block apply/planning.
Integrity proof tampers operation/finding binding/hash and proves apply rejection.
Atomic apply proof verifies input immutability, canonical setter use, Page Schema validation and targeted postcondition resolution.
Authority-boundary scan proves no AI gateway, Smart Intent parser, save/publish/persistence or pixel-to-repair logic.
Active V3 proof verifies per-finding plan, visible explanation, READY-only apply and exactly one history commit.
Maturity proof promotes only VX-SMART-AUTOFIX and preserves the separate final-rehearsal prohibition on Template #3 authoring.
Incremental replay, full Quality tests, TypeScript, production build, exact-head Template Factory proof, Completion Truth and lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Smart Auto-Fix produces executable repairs only from explicit source-verified safe registry entries; unsupported, semantic and pixel-only findings remain non-executable.

requirements.requirement: READY repair plans are fingerprint/hash bound, use existing canonical setters, validate Page Schema and prove the targeted postcondition before returning an atomic changed document.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Stale or tampered repair plans cannot apply.

requirements.requirement: Active V3 exposes preview-first per-finding Auto-Fix with READY-only apply and one ordinary Builder history commit.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: V3 cannot auto-apply repair during rendering/planning or bypass ordinary history.

requirements.requirement: VX-SMART-AUTOFIX is promoted only after Core and active V3 proof; technical capability completion does not bypass the separately required final end-to-end Brabus rehearsal before Template #3 authoring.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Auto-Fix maturity promotion alone cannot start Template #3 authoring.

notes: Thirteenth Brabus hardening wave. Publish Readiness and Smart Intent are lifecycle-closed and PROVEN on parent 568e2d2c509bb58e5d00f07963bc3b2f187e7f01. Auto-Fix is deliberately narrower than 'repair every structured diagnostic': explicit safe registry membership is the repair authority. Template #3 remains forbidden until the final end-to-end Brabus rehearsal passes even if this wave clears the last maturity blocker. Plan projection narrowed to the measured Auto-Fix transaction: DOMAIN-ADMIN + DOMAIN-BUILDER, admin/builder authorities, no database-schema subsystem. Two critical challenges were rewritten with exact diagnostic codes, mutation risk and executable fail-closed outcomes. After the Core file entered the actual diff, Atlas correctly resolved its canonical Page Schema/runtime validation dependency as DOMAIN-STOREFRONT/shared-storefront. This is consumption of existing authority, not a new storefront authority; database-schema remains out of scope. Reference Sync fingerprint 3b038645 is an exact exception for generator-readiness' undeclared Blueprint return path: template3AuthoringReady:false remains intentionally fail-closed when no Blueprint is declared and is independent of the now-PROVEN Smart Auto-Fix maturity row.
